name: NEVERMINE
source:
Crawl Moonwards.

A psycho-cosmic experience, NEVERMINE is a surreal and experimental interactive fiction game.  Meet a talking crow,  escape your memories, face Humanity's Corpse. 

An entity, standing at the center of the intersection.
It takes me a few more flashes to discern the shape, but i see.
A figure... one mishapen and bent, but a figure... and i recognise it.
That is what was behind the door. that is what i am running from.
But it's here?
...
"What are you?"

[From [url=https://elzibeht.itch.io/nevermine]Itch.io[/url]]
